name: HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Flagship (Magnetic, 20-Magnet Ball-Core)
description: The HaiTun WaveRider 3x3 V2 Flagship is a 56 mm magnetic speed cube built around a spherical ball-core with 20 core magnets and 6 magnetic rings, tuned for a lively, accelerated turning feel at a lightweight 72 g. It's the version that puts the redesigned core front and center — high magnetic acceleration without the extra positioning hardware of the heavier builds.
features: Comfortable for long sessions: 56 mm golden size and a 72 g weight keep control high and fatigue low through extended practice.
Quiet by design: Full lubrication and high-precision processing keep turning noise down for everyday cubing.
Micro-numerical setting: Numbered dials let you replicate a specific setup precisely and repeat it, so a good configuration is never lost.
Spring compression & center tension: Adjust both independently across 8 levels each for a wide range of tactile feedback.
Auto-alignment: Magnetic repulsion combined with inertia provides acceleration and auto-assisted homing for smooth operation with solid stability.
Spherical ball-core levitation system: An integrated core with a spherical magnetic levitation setup delivers auto-alignment and increased stability.
